@MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.restrict_preimage : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} β]
  {μa : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} α} {μb : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} β} {f : α → β},
  MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.{u_1, u_2} f μa μb →
    ∀ {s : Set.{u_2} β},
      MeasurableSet.{u_2} s →
        MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.{u_1, u_2} f
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict.{u_1} μa (Set.preimage.{u_1, u_2} f s))
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict.{u_2} μb s)
